## File: facebookresearch_motif/rl_baseline/sample-factory/sample_factory/envs/doom/scripts/generate_bots.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to generate 100 Doom bot configuration blocks across 10 difficulty levels', 'create a bot parameter value using a normal distribution centered on the given difficulty level', 'create a Doom bot configuration string with randomized aiming, perfection, reaction, and isp values', 'test the bot_param function to ensure it clamps values between 1 and 100', 'refactor fmt_bot to enable the weapon preference string in the generated bot configuration']
```

Usage

```
{'run_generate_bots': 'run the script to generate 100 Doom bot configuration blocks across 10 difficulty levels', 'create_bot_param': 'create a bot parameter value using a normal distribution centered on the given difficulty level', 'create_fmt_bot': 'create a Doom bot configuration string with randomized aiming, perfection, reaction, and isp values', 'test_bot_param': 'test the bot_param function to ensure it clamps values between 1 and 100', 'refactor_fmt_bot': 'refactor fmt_bot to enable the weapon preference string in the generated bot configuration'}
```
